topic.title: Stub a job that changes state

body.p: Stub the job endpoint with four responses, sent in order. The first is queued, with status 202 and a retry-after header. The others are the list of finished stages, the running status, and the done status in job.json.
Open the test site at http://localhost:8092/.
Fetch /api/jobs/1 five times. Each request gets the next response. The fifth request gets job.json again, because the last response answers every later request.
